name: Chat Translation
description:
Translates eligible incoming and outgoing chat through Google Translate.

It can auto-translate outgoing and incoming messsages:
- Shift + Left Click on the translate button to enable auto-translation of outgoing messages.
- Shift + Right Click on the translate button to enable auto-translation of incoming messages.

It can also translate messages on demand:
- Left Click on the translate button to translate outgoing messages.
- Right Click on the translate button to translate incoming messages.
- Shift + Right Click the translate button to enable auto-translation of incoming messages.
